title: Tytuvėnai Monastery Second Livestock Barn

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified open elevation tile data sampled at the independent building anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: Lithuanian GRPK registry footprint and individual Cultural Heritage Register location
mapIdentity.scope: The eastern leg is identified in the heritage locator. Its country cadastral shape shares a party edge with the northern barn, with outbuilding division set from the inner corner and the survey lengths.

note: The short, perpendicular one-storey livestock barn has brick and fieldstone walls, a low basement exposure, a simple gable roof and small rectangular openings.
